faqs.question: Does Epson make drivers for Linux?
faqs.answer:
Linux drivers are available for some products. Visit the links below to see the drivers available for your product, as well as information about using an Epson product with Linux.
Note:
Epson does not provide support for Linux drivers.
Linux drivers for Epson products
Linux FAQs for Epson products
(only available in English)
Linux manuals for Epson products
(only available in English)

faqs.question: I am unable to connect my product to a wireless network. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with built-in wireless features and does not support a wireless (or Ethernet) connection to a network router. Only a direct wired connection to the computer is supported.

faqs.question: How do I obtain the latest product software for Windows or my Mac?
faqs.answer: You can download the latest product driver from the Downloads section of this website.

faqs.question: Can the printer still print if an ink cartridge is expended or not installed?
faqs.answer: No. The printer will not operate if any cartridge is expended or removed. It's best to always have extra cartridges on hand.

faqs.question: Can the Epson ink cartridges be refilled or can I use third-party ink cartridges without voiding the warranty?
faqs.answer:
Epson does not recommend refilling or using other brands of ink cartridges.  Epson uses a permanent Micro Piezo print head that has allowed Epson to lead the industry in delivering consistent photo image quality by using variable-sized droplets.  Micro Piezo print head can also use a wider variety of inks, which has allowed Epson to introduce such ink breakthroughs as DURABrite® and Epson UltraChrome® inks that offer greatly improved humidity resistance, smudge resistance, and fade resistance.
Using refilled ink cartridges will not void the product's original warranty; however, if these products cause a failure, the repair of that failure will not be covered under warranty.

faqs.question: My product makes noise after I turn it on or after it has been sitting for a while. What should I do?
faqs.answer: This is normal. It is performing routine maintenance.

faqs.question: I brought my product with me to a different country and can't find ink for it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Some Epson printers and ink cartridges are specific to a regional market and not sold worldwide, although the same printers are sold in the U.S. and Canada. If you have a printer sold in the U.S. or Canada, you may not be able to easily get ink cartridges for it in foreign markets.
Unfortunately, because of customs and tax regulations, the Epson E-Stores in the U.S. and Canada are unable to ship to addresses outside the U.S. and Canada.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: Does my product support Epson Connect?
faqs.answer: No, your product is not compatible.

faqs.question: Can I print on envelopes?
faqs.answer: No.

faqs.question: How do I print a borderless photo from Windows or my Mac?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
For Windows, click the
Borderless
checkbox on the
Main
tab of the printer driver, select a compatible borderless paper size and type.
For a Macintosh, select a paper size with the
Borderless
option on the Print window. To use the borderless option, you'll need to select a paper size with the a
Sheet Feeder - Borderless
option.

faqs.question: Can I print on CDs and DVDs?
faqs.answer:
Yes. See
Printing on CDs and DVDs
for details.

faqs.question: The CD/DVD won't feed correctly or is ejected. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure you insert the CD/DVD tray correctly. See
Loading a CD or DVD
.
If the CD/DVD tray won't load or jams in the printer, gently pull out the CD/DVD tray and press the
paper button, if it is flashing. Then reload the tray, making sure the CD/DVD tray is inserted correctly in the tray guides.
Make sure the surface of the CD/DVD you are printing on is blank and clean. A CD/DVD with images or text already on the surface area may not load correctly.

Devices and Printer
window before you print.
Clear space on your hard drive or run a defragmentation utility to free up existing space.
Close any programs that you're not using when you print.
If your product is connected to a USB hub, connect it directly to your computer instead.
If printing becomes slower after printing continuously for a long time, the product may have automatically slowed down to protect the print mechanism from

faqs.question: Does OS X support manual duplex printing with my product?
faqs.answer: This feature is not supported in Mac OS X. However, if your printer has a built-in automatic duplexer, auto-duplexing is supported in Mac OS X 10.6 (Snow Leopard).

faqs.question: I see the message Print queue was not added after I install my product driver from my product CD in OS X 10.5. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Restart your Mac; it will automatically create the print queue.

faqs.question: I see a communication error when I try to print with a USB connection. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure the USB cable is a shielded "AB" cable not more than 10 feet long.
Note:
Do not use devices that extend the length of the cable because they can cause signal degradation.
If you're using a USB hub with your printer, connect the printer directly to your computer.
Note:
Do not connect through a USB keyboard.  The keyboard acts like a hub and can interfere with signal transmission.
Use a different port on your computer.
Make sure there is no error on the printer.

faqs.question: I keep getting Paper jam, CD/DVD tray, or thick paper jam message right before printing when using the single sheet guide. The paper is not jammed and I am not printing on CD/DVDs. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The paper is not loading correctly. You'll need to reload the paper without canceling the print job in the print queue. Do the following:
Press the
Roll
paper button for 3 seconds to eject the paper.
Remove the paper completely from the printer.
Press the flashing
Paper
button once to clear the paper out error, the paper light now becomes solid green.
Reload paper in the single sheet guide again and try printing.

faqs.question: I see the message Cannot connect to Internet in Windows 8.1 after I select Driver Update in my product software. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The
Driver Update
option does not work in Windows 8.1. All other driver options will work correctly.

faqs.question: How long should an ink cartridge remain in my product if it's not used often?
faqs.answer: When an installed ink cartridge is more than six months old, you may need to replace it if you notice that your printouts don't look as good as they used to and quality doesn't improve after cleaning and aligning the print head.

faqs.question: A color ink cartridge is expended even though I print in black only. Why does this happen?
faqs.answer:
To keep the print head clear and ready to print, the printer uses a small amount of ink from all the cartridges whenever it prints. Even if you select
Grayscale
, some color ink is still being used.

faqs.question: I installed new ink cartridges and my product seems to be doing a long cleaning cycle. Is this normal?
faqs.answer:
Yes. The first time you install ink cartridges, the printer must charge its print head for about 3 minutes. Wait until charging finishes (the
power light stops flashing) before you turn off the printer, or it may charge improperly and use excess ink the next time you turn it on.
If the printer stops moving or making noise, but the
power light is still flashing after 5 minutes, turn off the printer. If the light is still flashing when you turn it back on, contact Epson technical support for assistance.

faqs.question: How do I change the ink cartridges?
faqs.answer:
See
Replacing Ink Cartridges
.

faqs.question: How do I know when an ink cartridge needs to be replaced?
faqs.answer:
When the ink replace light is on, the printer will require you to change the cartridge. You need to replace a cartridge when it's expended or it gets too old. See
Replacing Ink Cartridges
.

faqs.question: Does my product come with both a Matte Black and Photo Black ink cartridge?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: How do I switch the black ink cartridge from one type to another?
faqs.answer:
See
Switching Black Ink Cartridge Types
.
Note:
If you plan to switch the black ink cartridge from one type to another, switch the cartridge before you open your printing software. If you open an image in your software and then switch the black ink cartridge, the printer driver may display invalid media settings.

faqs.question: Why do I need to switch between Matte Black and Photo Black ink cartridges?
faqs.answer: The standard Photo Black ink has been optimized for RC and Photographic grade media types. If you're printing on matte-type papers such as Epson Velvet Fine Art, Premium Presentation Paper Matte, or UltraSmooth Fine Art, your black density is significantly better when using Matte Black ink.

faqs.question: Can the Epson ink cartridges be refilled or can I use third-party ink cartridges without voiding the warranty?
faqs.answer:
Epson does not recommend refilling or using other brands of ink cartridges.  Epson uses a permanent Micro Piezo print head that has allowed Epson to lead the industry in delivering consistent photo image quality by using variable-sized droplets.  Micro Piezo print head can also use a wider variety of inks, which has allowed Epson to introduce such ink breakthroughs as DURABrite® and Epson UltraChrome® inks that offer greatly improved humidity resistance, smudge resistance, and fade resistance.
Using refilled ink cartridges will not void the product's original warranty; however, if these products cause a failure, the repair of that failure will not be covered under warranty.

faqs.question: Can the printer still print if an ink cartridge is expended or not installed?
faqs.answer: No. The printer will not operate if any cartridge is expended or removed. It's best to always have extra cartridges on hand.

faqs.question: I brought my product with me to a different country and can't find ink for it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Some Epson printers and ink cartridges are specific to a regional market and not sold worldwide, although the same printers are sold in the U.S. and Canada. If you have a printer sold in the U.S. or Canada, you may not be able to easily get ink cartridges for it in foreign markets.
Unfortunately, because of customs and tax regulations, the Epson E-Stores in the U.S. and Canada are unable to ship to addresses outside the U.S. and Canada.

faqs.question: Does my all-in-one printer support non-printing functions when an ink cartridge is expended or not installed?
faqs.answer:
See our
FAQ page
on which non-printing functions are supported.

faqs.question: How do I clean and maintain my product?
faqs.answer:
In order to keep your printer clean, it is recommended that you keep it covered when not in use.  This will prevent dust from settling inside the printer. You should not operate the printer in an excessively dusty environment.
If the printer should require cleaning, we recommend using a mild detergent and water with a soft cloth to wipe the outside of the printer. Do not clean any internal parts of the printer.
To clean the paper pick-up rollers and paper feed path, use cleaning sheets which can be purchased from the Epson Store. The cleaning sheet part number is S041150.  The cleaning sheets help correct issues related to inconsistent paper feed.

faqs.answer:
Follow the steps below:
Load a few sheets of plain paper in the sheet feeder.

Follow the on-screen instructions to print the nozzle check pattern.
Check the nozzle check pattern that prints to see if there are gaps in the lines.
If there are no gaps, the print head is clean and you're done.
If there are gaps or the pattern is faint, click
Clean

After the printer has finished cleaning, click

or
Print
and another nozzle check pattern will print. If it is without any gaps or missing lines, click on
Finish
. Otherwise, click
Clean
.
If necessary, repeat cleaning two more times. If the situation continues after three cleaning cycles, replace the affected ink cartridge(s).

faqs.question: How should I store my product if it's not going to be used for a long time?
faqs.answer:
Epson recommends storing the product in a cool, dry environment. See your product's documentation for recommended storage temperatures.
Check the ink cartridge before placing the product in storage. If the ink cartridge is very low or expended, Epson recommends replacing it with a new ink cartridge to help prevent the print head from drying out. When taking the product out of storage, check the ink cartridge again to see if it has expired. If the cartridge is expired and you experience print quality issues, you may need to replace the expired ink cartridge to improve print quality.
Make sure to turn off the product using the power button and unplug the power cord before placing it in storage. Cover the product to protect it from dust.

faqs.question: Can I use sheet labels with my product?
faqs.answer:
You can use Epson's
Photo Quality Self Adhesive Sheets
. A cutting grid is printed on the reverse side of each sheet for easy custom trimming. To avoid paper jams, load only one sheet at a time. Also, set the
Type
or
Media Type
setting in the driver to
Premium Presentation Paper Matte
.

faqs.question: How can I stop my product from feeding multiple pages at the same time?
faqs.answer: If multiple pages feed at once, remove the paper from the sheet feeder, fan the edges to separate the sheets, then reload it.

faqs.question: Which paper type setting should I select when using PremierArt Water Resistant Canvas for Epson?
faqs.answer:
Select
UltraSmooth Fine Art Paper
.

faqs.question: Does the type of paper I use really make a difference?
faqs.answer:
The type of paper you choose affects the way your printout looks, so be sure to select the correct paper for your print job. If you are just printing a rough draft of an image, plain paper is fine. For the best results, however, you'll want to use one of Epson's special ink jet papers designed for your printer. See
Available Epson Papers
.

faqs.question: How do I know which paper or media type to select in my product's driver?
faqs.answer:
See
Selecting the Correct Paper Type
.

faqs.question: What kind of paper gives the best results for high quality printing?
faqs.answer: For the best results, you'll want to use one of Epson's special ink jet papers designed for your printer. For example, your photos will look great printed on Epson Ultra Premium Photo Paper Glossy, Epson Ultra Premium Presentation Paper Matte, and Epson Ultra Premium Photo Paper Luster.

faqs.question: Can I print on transparencies?
faqs.answer: No.

faqs.question: How do I load roll paper?
faqs.answer:
See
Loading Roll Paper
.

faqs.question: How do I load thick paper?
faqs.answer:
See
Loading Thick Media
.

faqs.question: How can I solve paper feeding problems?
faqs.answer:
If the paper doesn't feed properly or jams in the sheet feeder, manual feed slots, or roll paper slot, Do the following:
Sheet Feeder:
If paper jams in the printer, press the
paper button to eject any jammed sheets, then open the printer cover and remove any paper jammed inside. Press the
paper button again to clear the error.
If paper doesn't feed, remove it from the sheet feeder. Reload it against the right side, then slide the edge guide against the paper.
Make sure the paper loaded in the sheet feeder is not above the arrow mark inside the edge guide.
If multiple pages feed at once, remove the paper from the sheet feeder, fan the edges to separate the sheets, then reload it.
Make sure you don't load more than the recommended number of sheets. If you're printing on both sides of the paper, try loading fewer sheets.
Paper type

Plain paper
Epson Bright White Paper
Epson Presentation Paper Matte

Epson Premium Photo Paper Glossy
Epson Ultra Premium Photo Paper Glossy
Epson Premium Photo Paper Semi-gloss
Epson Premium Presentation Paper Matte
Epson Premium Presentation Paper Matte Double-Sided
20
Epson Photo Quality Self-Adhesive Sheets
Epson Iron-On Cool Peel Transfer Paper
1
Make sure you use new, smooth, high-quality paper that is not curled, creased, old, or too thin. Load it printable side up.
If the paper loaded from the sheet feeder doesn't eject fully, you may have selected the wrong paper size in the printer software. Press the
paper button, then open the printer cover and remove the paper. Select the correct paper size when you reprint.
If it's wrinkled when it ejects, the paper may be damp or too thin. (If the paper is damp after printing, you may have selected the wrong media type setting in the printer software).
Rear Manual Feed Slot:
If paper jams in the printer, press the
paper button to eject any jammed sheets, then open the printer cover and remove any paper jammed inside. Press the
paper button again to clear the error.
If paper doesn't feed, remove it from the single sheet guide. Reload it against the right side, then slide the edge guide against the paper.
Make sure you use new, smooth, high-quality paper that is not curled, creased, old, or too thin. Load it printable side up.
If the paper loaded from the rear manual feed slot doesn't eject fully, you may have selected the wrong paper size in the printer software. Press the
paper button, then open the printer cover and remove the paper. Select the correct paper size when you reprint.
If it's wrinkled when it ejects, the paper may be damp or too thin. (If the paper is damp after printing, you may have selected the wrong media type setting in the printer software).
Roll Paper Slot:
If paper jams in the printer, cut off any printed roll paper or canvas media. Press and hold the
roll paper button for three seconds to back the paper out. Remove the paper from the printer, press the
paper button to clear the paper out error, and load the paper again.
If roll paper doesn't feed, cut the end of it straight across and uncurl the end by rolling it backwards, if necessary.
If it's wrinkled when it ejects, the paper may be damp or too thin. (If the paper is damp after printing, you may have selected the wrong media type setting in the printer software).
Front Manual Feed Slot:
If paper jams in the printer, gently pull out the paper and press the
paper button to clear the error.
If paper doesn't feed, remove it from the front manual feed slot. Reload it against the right side, then slide the edge guide against the paper.
Load only one piece of 1.0 to 1.3 mm thick 13 x 19-inch media in the front manual feed slot. Make sure that the trailing edge of the media is aligned with the arrows on the front manual feed slot and that there is enough space behind the printer for the media to feed through the printer.
Make sure you use new, smooth, high-quality paper that is not curled, creased, old, or too thin. Load it printable side up.
If it's wrinkled when it ejects, the paper may be damp or too thin. (If the paper is damp after printing, you may have selected the wrong media type setting in the printer software).

faqs.question: How do I create a custom paper size in the Server Properties?
faqs.answer:
Follow these steps to create a new page size accessible by all printer drivers installed in Windows:
Open the
Printers
or
Printers and Faxes
window.
Click
File
, then
Server Properties
.
Put a check in the
Create a new form
box.
Input a name for the custom paper size.
Under
Paper Size
, enter the desired height and width.
Click
Save
or
Save Form
to add the new form size to the list, then
OK
to close Server Properties.

faqs.question: How should I handle specialty paper like fine art media?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Always use one sheet at a time.
Use lint-free cotton gloves when handling the media.
Never stack prints on top of each other. Use a separator sheet between prints.
Store media flat. Never store media on its side.
Store media in a cool, dry environment. Refer to the media specification sheet for proper temperature and humidity requirements.
Always follow the specific loading instructions for the media being used.
Use the proper media type setting (EMX).
Note:
Non-Epson media can be optimized using custom media settings created in Epson Media Installer.

faqs.question: Which Epson Professional papers do not have optical brighteners?
faqs.answer: Hot Press Natural, Cold Press Natural, and UltraSmooth Fine Art Paper.

faqs.question: Heavy coated or thick paper does not load correctly or loads skewed. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The paper you are using may be too heavy or glossy for the paper roller to pick up. Be sure the paper is within printer specifications.

faqs.question: The image look inverted, as if viewed in a mirror. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
You may have accidentally selected the
Mirror Image
or
Rotate 180°
option in the printer driver or a similar feature in your software application. Make sure the settings are not turned on in the printer driver or in your application program. (If you're printing on Epson Iron-On Transfer Paper, the image should be inverted.)

faqs.question: My printout has lines running through it. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
The print head nozzles may need to be
checked and cleaned
.
Select a higher
Print Quality
and turn off
High Speed
mode in the printer software.
Make sure the Media Type setting matches the paper you loaded.
Make sure the printable side of the paper is face-up. It's usually brighter or whiter.
On a Macintosh, try using
Automatic
mode.
Make sure you're using genuine Epson ink cartridges and you use them within six months after you open the packages.
Align
the print head.
The ink cartridges may need
replacing
.

faqs.question: The quality of my printed output is unacceptable. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
If the image looks fine on your computer screen but you're not happy with the output, make sure you're using the correct driver for your printer. If that doesn't help, see
Print Quality Problems
.

faqs.question: My printout has incorrect margins. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure the paper settings are correct for your paper size in the printer software.
Choose the correct margins for your paper size in your printing program.
Use the
Print Preview
option in your Windows printer software to check your margins before you print.
Use the
Preview
button in the Macintosh Print window to check your margins before you print.
Make sure your paper is positioned next to the right side of the feeder.
If you're printing from a web browser, the pages may not print correctly due to the web page design. Try one of the following:
Check to see if there is a
Printer Friendly Version
(or similarly named) icon or link on the web page that you can click on.
Experiment with page setup and paper size, then select
Print Preview
from the
File
menu in your application to view the changes.
You may need to reinstall your printer software.

faqs.question: My printout is blurry or smeared. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure your paper isn't damp or curled, or loaded face-down (the printable side should be face-up). It's usually brighter or whiter.
Use a support sheet with special paper, or try loading your paper one sheet at a time.
Make sure your paper meets the specifications. Also, it is important to
select the correct paper type
.
Use Epson papers to ensure proper saturation and absorption of genuine Epson inks. Also, make sure you're using genuine Epson ink cartridges.
Align
the print head.
Remove each sheet from the front tray as it is printed.
The printer won't operate properly if it's tilted or at an angle. Place it on a flat, stable surface that extends beyond the printer base in all directions.
Avoid handling printouts for a few hours to allow the ink to set.  Let your prints dry separately for at least 12 hours before framing or placing them in protective sheets.  If you need to stack them, place a sheet of plain paper between each print.
Turn off
High Speed
mode in the printer software.
Turn on the following settings and try printing again:
Windows
: Access the
printer settings window
. On the Main tab, click the
Paper Config
button and set the Platen Gap to
Wide
. Then click the
Utility
tab, select
Speed and Progress
, and click the
Check paper width before printing
checkbox.
Macintosh OS X 10.5
: Open the
Print window
, select
Paper Configuration
from the pop-up menu, and turn on the
Thick paper
and
Check paper width before printing
settings.
Mac OS X 10.3 to 10.4
: Open the
Print window
, select
Paper Configuration
from the popup menu, and turn on the
Thick paper
and
Check paper width before printing
settings.
If you are using double-sided paper and printing heavily saturated or dark images on the front side of the paper, you may notice that smudges or marks appear on the front when you print the second side. If one side of the paper will contain a lighter image or text, print that side first to eliminate marks or smudging.
Load a new sheet of plain paper and press the
paper button to eject it. Do this several times. If the printouts are still blurry or smeared, ink may have leaked inside the printer, and you need to clean the printer. See
Cleaning the Rollers
.
If you are having this problem while printing on a CD or DVD, make sure you're using an ink jet-printable CD or DVD, and handle the disc carefully. Allow the ink to dry for at least 24 hours before inserting the disc in a drive.
You may need to uninstall your printer software and then reinstall it.

faqs.question: My product is printing blank pages. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure the
print head nozzles
are not clogged.
In Windows, make sure
EPSON Stylus Photo R2880
is selected as your printer. In Mac OS X 10.5, make sure
Stylus Photo R2880
is selected in the Print window. In Mac OS X 10.3 to 10.4, make sure
Stylus Photo R2880
is selected in the Page Setup and Print windows.
Make sure the printer software settings are appropriate for the paper size you're using.
The ink cartridges may be old or low on ink, and you may need to
replace them
.
The printer won't operate properly if it's tilted or at an angle. Place it on a flat, stable surface that extends beyond the printer base in all directions.
Try printing a different document to determine if the problem is limited to one document. If the problem is with one document, try recreating the document.
You may need to reinstall your printer software.

faqs.question: My printout is grainy when I print from any application. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure the printable side of the paper is face-up. It's usually brighter or whiter.
Select a higher
Print Quality
, and turn off
High Speed
mode in the printer software.
Select
Max Quality
(Windows) or
SuperPhoto - 5760dpi
(Macintosh) as the Print Quality. Remember that this setting increases print time.
Align
the print head.
You may need to increase the resolution of your image or print in a smaller size; see your software documentation.

faqs.question: My printout contains garbled characters when I print from Windows or my Mac. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure the USB cable is a shielded “AB” cable not more then 6.5 feet (2 meters) long.
If you're using a switch box or USB hub with your printer, connect the printer directly to your computer.
Turn the printer off, check that the cables are securely connected, turn it back on, then try printing again.
You may need to reinstall your printer software.

faqs.question: My printout has incorrect or missing colors. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The problem could be due to a software setting, the condition of the printer, or the paper you're using. Check the following:
Make sure the color setting in your Macintosh printer software is not set to
Grayscale
.
The print head nozzles may need
cleaning
.
The ink cartridges may be old or low on ink, and you may need to
replace them
.
Try turning off
PhotoEnhance
in the Windows printer software.
On a Macintosh, try using
Automatic
mode.
Try changing the
Gamma
setting in your printer software.
Your printed colors can never exactly match your on-screen colors. However, you can use a color management system to get as close as possible. Try using the
ICM
(Windows) or
ColorSync
(Macintosh) setting, or use a color-managed workflow.
If you're using color management in your application, select
Off (No Color Adjustment)
to disable color management in the printer software.
For best results, use genuine Epson ink and paper.
After you print, the colors on your printout will take some time to set as the ink dries. During this time, the colors may look different than you expect. To reduce the drying time, avoid stacking your prints on top of each other.

faqs.question: The printout has a slight slant. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Make sure you have
loaded the paper
correctly.
Align
the print head.

faqs.question: My product sounds as though it is printing, but nothing prints. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The print head nozzles may be clogged. Try
cleaning the print head
.

faqs.question: I upgraded to Photoshop CS4 and now my prints come out darker than what is displayed on my monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try turning off the color management in Photoshop and make sure you are using the color management in the printer driver.  Do the following:
Windows:
In the printer driver, under Mode, click
Custom
, then select
Color Controls
.
In Photoshop, open your file and select
Print
from the File menu.  Then choose
No Color Management
for Color Handling.
Macintosh:
In the final print window under Layout, select
Print Settings
or
Printer Settings
.  For Color Mode, select
Color Controls
, and choose
Epson Standard sRGB
,
Adobe RGB
, or another selection if appropriate.

faqs.question: I am printing a PostScript file and the edges of the text in my printout are not straight or the printout does not match the color shown on my monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Your product is not a PostScript printer so you may see unexpected results when printing a PostScript file. To print PostScript files in high quality, Epson recommends using a RIP software which will create a raster image from the PostScript code and then send it to your product to print.
If a RIP software is unavailable, you may be able to obtain high quality prints by saving and printing your document/images as a PDF file instead of a PostScript file.

faqs.question: Web pages don't print the way they appear on my monitor. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
The pages may not print correctly due to the web page design. Try the following:
Check for a
Printer-friendly Version
(or similarly named) option on the web page.
Change the page setup and paper size settings, and select the preview option in your browser to check the changes before you print.

faqs.question: Why is the Buy Epson Ink button not working in the Low Ink Reminder utility?
faqs.answer: Your driver may need to be updated. Download the latest printer driver from the Downloads tab for your product. If installing the latest printer driver does not fix the problem, you can order ink from the Epson Store.

faqs.question: I'm having problems installing the software. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure your printer is turned on and the USB cable is securely connected at both ends. If you still have problems, disconnect the USB cable and carefully follow the software installation instructions on the Start Here sheet (
Windows
or
Macintosh
).
Make sure your system meets the requirements.
Make sure all applications (including any screen savers and virus protectors) are closed before you install the software. If any applications were open, uninstall the software, then carefully follow the software installation instructions on the Start Here sheet (
Windows
or
Macintosh
).
If you see an error message or your software doesn't install correctly in Windows, you may not have software installation privileges. Contact your System Administrator.
Make sure the USB Controller is working properly in Device Manager. See your Windows help system for details. If it's not working, contact your computer manufacturer.
Uninstall the printer software, then carefully follow the software installation instructions on the Start Here sheet (
Windows
or
Macintosh
).
Note:
You must connect the printer to your computer at the correct time to make sure the driver is installed correctly on your computer. Carefully follow the software installation instructions on the Start Here sheet.

faqs.question: I cancelled the software installation before it was complete, or connected the USB cable before starting the software installation. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
First uninstall the software, then reinstall the software.
Note:
You must connect the printer to your computer at the correct time to make sure the driver is installed correctly on your computer. Carefully follow the software installation instructions on the Start Here sheet (
Windows
or
Macintosh
).

faqs.question: Can I select a print resolution by indicating a specific dpi (dots per inch) setting?
faqs.answer:
No. The print resolution is determined by other driver software settings.
In Windows, the
Print Quality
and
Media Type
settings determine the print resolution. See
Printing in Windows
.
In Mac OS X 10.5, the
Print Quality
and
Media Type
settings determine the print resolution. See
Printing With Mac OS X 10.5
.
In Mac OS X 10.3 to 10.4, the resolution settings depend on the
Mode
setting (see
Printing With Mac OS X 10.3 to 10.4
):
Note:
To access the resolution settings in Mac OS X, select
Print
from the
File
menu. Then select
Print Settings
from the pull-down menu.
If you've selected
Automatic
as the
Mode
setting, the resolution is determined by the
Media Type
setting and the position of the Quality/Speed slider.
If you've selected
Advanced
as the
Mode
setting, the resolution is determined by the
Media Type
setting and the
Print Quality
setting.

faqs.question: My product software doesn't work properly. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure your
Windows software is installed correctly
or your
Macintosh software is installed correctly
.
Also, make sure your computer meets the system requirements.
The problem could also be caused by settings in your operating system. See
Solving Problems
for more information.

faqs.question: When I use the Advanced B&W Photo setting in my product driver, which color management settings should I select in Photoshop?
faqs.answer:
When
Advanced B&W Photo
is selected the printer driver manages the color, so you should disable color management in Photoshop. Disable color management in Photoshop by following one of these steps:
Photoshop CS3
: Select
Printer Manages Color
as your Color Handling setting (in the Print window).
Photoshop CS2
: Select
No Color Management
as your Color Handling setting (in the Print with Preview window).
Photoshop CS or 7
:  Select
Same as Source
as your Printer Profile setting (in the Print with Preview window).
Your file does not need to be converted to grayscale.

faqs.question: The Advanced B&W Photo setting is grayed out in my product driver. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Check the following:
Make sure you install the correct black ink cartridge for the media type selected. When the photo black cartridge is installed, the
Advanced B&W Photo
setting is available only for glossy media types. It is not available for any of the matte media types. When the matte black cartridge is installed, the
Advanced B&W Photo
setting is available only for matte media types.
If you plan to switch the black ink cartridge from one type to another, switch the cartridge before you open your printing software. If you open an image in your software and then switch the black ink cartridge, your printer driver may display invalid media settings.
On a Macintosh, if you're using the correct black ink cartridge for your media type but the
Advanced B&W Photo
setting is still grayed out, Do the following:
Open the
Hard Drive
.
Select
Applications
>
EPSON Printer Utility 3
.
Select your printer and click
OK
.
Click
EPSON Status Monitor
, make sure you see the ink levels in the status window, then click
Update
.

faqs.question: Why are my images being expanded when I print borderless photos with the Retain Size setting selected?
faqs.answer: Your driver may need to be updated. Download the latest printer driver from the Downloads tab for your product. If installing the latest printer driver does not fix the problem, contact Epson Support.

faqs.question: How do I set default print settings when I print from Windows?
faqs.answer:
When you change your print settings from within a program, the changes apply only while you're printing at that time. If you want to select different settings to use in all your Windows programs, you can change the default print settings.
Right-click the
icon in the bottom right corner of your screen (the taskbar).
Select
Printer Settings
. You see the printer settings window:
Select the print settings you want to use as defaults in all your Windows programs. You can still change the default settings from within a program as needed.

faqs.question: Can I connect more than one computer to my product at the same time?
faqs.answer: Yes. The printer has two USB ports, so you can connect two computers at the same time. If both computers send a print job at the same time, a busy message appears on one of the computers.

faqs.question: I upgraded my system software to OS X 10.6.x. Now when I open the Epson Print CD software, a message appears and the Epson Print CD software quits unexpectedly. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Try the following:
Turn off the printer.
Click the Spotlight
icon in the upper-right corner of your screen. In the search field type
Epson
, then click
Show All
.
Select all the files and folders with
Epson
in the name and drag them to the trash.
Open your hard drive, select
Library
>
Printers
, the
Epson
folder and drag it to the trash.
On your hard drive, select
Users
>
Library
>
Preferences
>
Epson
, select the files named
com.apple.print.
[XXXXXXX]
.plist
(XXXXXX represents any name)	and then drag the files to the trash.
From the Apple menu, select
System Preferences
and click
Print & Fax
.
Press the
Control
and
Apple
button on your keyboard at the same time, then click anywhere in the printer list. Select
Reset printing system...
.
Click
OK
, when you see the screen below.
Note:
Resetting the printing system will remove all printers from the
Printer
list. You'll need to
Add
the printers you want again.
Restart
your Mac.
Reinstall the Mac OS X 10.6.x upgrade.
From the Apple menu, select
System Preferences
and then click
Print & Fax
.
Turn on the printer. Your Mac will add the printer automatically. If your printer does not appear automatically try the following:
Update your version of Mac OS X 10.6.x. If there is a driver available for your printer in a later version of Mac OS X 10.6.x, your Mac will automatically add the printer when you turn the printer on.
Check if there is a Macintosh OS X 10.6.x driver available from the
Downloads
tab for your product. If it's available, download the driver and follow the on-screen installation instructions to install driver.

faqs.question: How can I select the Advanced B&W Photo mode in my product software using Adobe Photoshop CS5?
faqs.answer:
Do the following:
Open an image in Photoshop CS5.
Click
File
then
Print
.
Select the Stylus Photo R2880 printer.
Select
Printer Manages Colors
below Color Handling.
Click
Print Settings
below Copies.
Click the drop-down menu next to Layout and select
Printer Features
.
Click the drop-down menu next to Color and select
Advanced B&W Photo
.
Click
Save
.

faqs.question: Why can't I find the media type in the drop-down menu after I downloaded the ICC profiles?
faqs.answer: An ICC profile is a file that describes how a particular device reproduces color. The profiles downloaded  from the Epson website do not change the quality settings in the driver (Text/Image, Photo, Best Photo, Photo RPM). The profiles are used in an application such as Photoshop to produce colors more accurately, so they stay consistent when printed.  When profiles are used properly, they serve to convert RGB values to CMYK and vice versa. The media types in the printer driver drop-down list do not change. If the media you are using is not listed, select the media type that is closest to the media you are printing on for best results. It is also recommended that you check the Paper section in the Epson support site for changes in media type names.

faqs.question: Are additional ICC profiles available for my product?
faqs.answer:
Yes. See
Premium ICC Printer Profiles for the Epson Stylus Photo R2880
for more information on obtaining ICC profiles and how to use them in a color-managed workflow.
Note:
ICC profiles are unavailable for Advanced Black & White Printing Mode.

faqs.question: Does my product support Epson Connect?
faqs.answer: No, your product is not compatible.

faqs.question: How do I obtain the latest product software for Windows or my Mac?
faqs.answer: You can download the latest product driver from the Downloads section of this website.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for support on the software that came with my product?
faqs.answer: Contact Epson for support on Epson software. For questions about any other software that came with your printer, contact the manufacturer.

faqs.question: How do I change the font size of text when I print from software in Windows?
faqs.answer: You need to select the text or font size in the software you are printing from, not the printer driver. For detailed instructions, contact the company for the application you are printing from.

faqs.question: Does Epson make drivers for Linux?
faqs.answer:
Linux drivers are available for some products. Visit the links below to see the drivers available for your product, as well as information about using an Epson product with Linux.
Note:
Epson does not provide support for Linux drivers.
Linux drivers for Epson products
Linux FAQs for Epson products
(only available in English)
Linux manuals for Epson products
(only available in English)

faqs.question: I can't find some of my printer's settings in macOS 12 or later. What should I do?
faqs.answer:
Make sure you're using the Epson driver for your printer. See our
Adding a Printer in macOS 12 or Later
page for instructions.

faqs.question: How do I add my Epson printer to the Printer list in macOS 12 or later?
faqs.answer:
See our
Adding a Printer in macOS 12 or Later
page for details.

faqs.question: How do I install a printer in Windows 11 24H2 or later?
faqs.answer:
See our
Installing a Printer in Windows 11 24H2 or Later
page for details.

faqs.question: I am unable to connect my product to a wireless network. What should I do?
faqs.answer: The printer does not come with built-in wireless features and does not support a wireless (or Ethernet) connection to a network router. Only a direct wired connection to the computer is supported.

faqs.question: What do the control panel lights indicate?
faqs.answer:
The lights indicate the printer's status
and let you know when a problem occurs. See the following table for details:
Light status
Problem and solution
power on
paper off
ink off
Printer is on and in a ready condition.
power on
paper off
ink on
An ink cartridge is expended or not installed correctly, or is not compatible with the printer. Replace or reinstall the cartridge.
power on
paper off
ink flashing
Ink in a cartridge is low. You can continue printing, or check which cartridge is low and replace it.
power on
paper flashing
ink off
Roll paper is being ejected from the printer. Remove any paper from the roll paper slot, then press the
paper button to eject the remaining paper.
power on
paper and
ink flashing alternately
An unsupported device is connected to the
external USB port. Connect only PictBridge/USB Direct Print compatible digital cameras to the
external USB port.
power flashing
paper on
ink off
Paper may be out. Load paper in the sheet feeder and press the
paper button.
If you're printing on roll paper or canvas media, it may be out. Load roll paper and press the
paper button.
If you're printing on a CD or DVD, the CD/DVD tray is not inserted or the CD on the CD/DVD tray is not detected. Insert the CD/DVD tray and press the
paper button.
If you're printing on thick media, the media is not inserted. Insert the thick media and press the
paper button.
power flashing
paper flashing
ink off
Paper may have jammed in the sheet feeder, rear manual feed slot, front manual feed slot, or roll paper slot.
Sheet Feeder or Rear Manual Feed Slot:
Press the
paper button to eject any jammed sheets, then open the printer cover and remove any paper jammed inside. Press the
paper button again to clear the error.
Front Manual Feed Slot:
Gently pull out the paper and press the
paper button to clear the error.
Roll Paper Slot:
Cut off any printed roll paper or canvas media, then remove and reload the paper.
The printer cover may be open. Close the printer cover to continue.
If you're printing on a CD or DVD, the CD/DVD tray may be unable to eject. Gently pull out the CD/DVD tray and press the
paper button.
If you're printing on roll paper, it may not be loaded correctly. Be sure to correctly align the roll paper when loading it.
power flashing
paper and
ink flashing simultaneously then alternately
The front manual feed slot cover is open while printing from paper loaded in the sheet feeder. Remove the loaded paper to print on thick media or a CD/DVD or close the front manual feed slot cover to print on paper loaded in the sheet feeder. Press the
paper button to clear the error.
If you're printing on a CD or DVD, the CD tray is not detected. Be sure to correctly insert the CD tray.
power off
paper and
ink flashing alternately
Parts inside the R2880 Series are at the end of their service life or an unknown error has occurred. Contact Epson for help.
power off
paper and
ink flashing fast
The print head is obstructed by paper or another foreign material. Turn off the printer, remove any obstructions, and turn it back on. If the error persists, contact Epson.

faqs.question: When printing in Windows, how can I prevent an extra page from being ejected after every print job?
faqs.answer:
The Separator Page function may be enabled. Follow these steps to disable it:
Click
Start
or
.
Do one of the following:
Windows XP
:
Select
Printers and Faxes
(or select
Settings
, then select
Printers and Faxes
).
Windows Vista
:
Select
Control Panel
, then
Printer
or
Printers
under Hardware and Sound
.
Windows 7
:
Select
Control Panel
, then
View Devices and Printers
under Hardware and Sound.
In the
Printers
or
Printers and Faxes
window, right-click on your printer's name.
Select
Properties
, click the Advanced tab, then press the
Separator Page
button.
In the Separator Page window, delete the information in the text box and then click
OK
.
Click
OK
again.

faqs.question: My product makes noise after I turn it on or after it has been sitting for a while. What should I do?
faqs.answer: This is normal. It is performing routine maintenance.

faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: Where do I find my product's serial number?
faqs.answer:
See our
Finding Your Epson Product Serial Number
page for details.
